title: PaymentGroup - Data API
description: Top-level object that groups all payment transactions that are processed for an order or invoice. PaymentGroup is a standalone object, so it isn’t required for users to execute payment transactions (authorizations, captures, refunds, and sales). This object is available in API version 48.0 and later.

PaymentGroupNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
PaymentGroupNumber.description: System-defined unique ID for the payment group.

SourceObjectId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SourceObjectId.description: The order or invoice related to all the payment transactions in the payment group. This is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To access Commerce Payments entities, your org must have a Salesforce Order Management license with the Payment Platform org permission activated. Commerce Payments entities are available only in Lightning Experience.
